mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity and supply, which is generally positive for equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals a shift in demand composition towards consumption, which is positive for consumer discretionary stocks, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS growth exceeded GDPC1 growth in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a month signals a strong labor market, which is generally positive for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased simultaneously within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals inflationary pressures, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in real GDP (GDPC1) is negative, it signals a contraction in economic activity, which is typically negative for equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 YoY change was negative.
